items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Interviewer: Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 84 pp.

Today is Thursday, February 18th, 2010, and this is the Smithsonian Institution National Endowment for the Arts Jazz Masters Oral History Program interview with Bill Holman in his house in Los Angeles, California. Good afternoon, Bill, accompanied by his wife, Nancy. This interview is conducted by Anthony Brown with Ken Kimery. Bill, if we could start with you stating your full name, your birth date, and where you were born.
My full name is Willis Leonard Holman. I was born in Olive, California, May 21st, 1927.
